title: First Public Release
items: Four Home scenes: Home now has four worlds: the 3D library, a night study, a sunset camp and a portal grotto (the new default, because purple). Pick yours in Settings, Look.
Everything moves smoother: Lists glide, panels crossfade and switching tabs stopped glitching. The Play button also stopped vanishing every time you changed tabs. It was shy.
A tidier Discover and Library: Discover keeps the list and the preview side by side with less clutter. Library lists your instances as neat rows, with Play on each.
Your cape, on your skin: The Skins page now shows your cape on your 3D character. Turn him around and admire it. Everyone else will.
Updates sit by the title now: The update button moved next to the page title with a little sparkle, so it stops looking like Downloads. Discover got a compass icon too.
Your reports, fixed: Screenshots inside mod folders and JPEGs show up, Home no longer flashes the wrong skin, and the buttons on screenshots work when you hover. Thanks, testers.
